Aye mere kapda odhne waale
Utho aur logon ko daraao
Aur apne Rabb ki buzurgi ka elaan karo
Aur apne libaas ko paakeeza rakho
Aur buraaiyon se parhez karo
Aur is tarah ehsaan na karo ke zyaada ke talabgaar ban jaao
Aur apne Rabb ki khaatir sabr karo
Phir jab Soor phoonka jaaega
To woh din intihaai mushkil din hoga
Kaafiron ke waaste to hargiz aasaan na hoga
Ab mujhe aur us shakhs ko chhod do jis ko main ne akela paida kiya hai
Aur us ke liye kaseer maal qaraar diya hai
Aur nigaah ke saamne rehne waale bete qaraar diye hain
Aur har tarah ke saamaan mein wus'at de di hai
Aur phir bhi chaahta hai ke aur izaafa kar doon
Hargiz nahin, ye hamaari nishaaniyon ka sakht dushman tha
To hum anqareeb ise sakht azaab mein giraftaar karenge
Is ne fikr ki aur andaaza lagaaya
To isi mein maara gaya ke kaisa andaaza lagaaya
Phir isi mein aur tabaah ho gaya ke kaisa andaaza lagaaya
Phir ghaur kiya
Phir tewari chadha kar munh basoor liya
Phir munh pher kar chala gaya aur akad gaya
Aur aakhir mein kehne laga ke ye to ek jaadoo hai jo puraane zamaane se chala aa raha hai
Ye to sirf insaan ka kalaam hai
Hum anqareeb ise Jahannam waasil kar denge
Aur tum kya jaano ke Jahannam kya hai
Woh kisi ko chhodne waala aur baaqi rakhne waala nahin hai
Badan ko jala kar siyaah kar dene waala hai
Us par unnees farishte mo'ayyan hain

Aur hum ne Jahannam ka nigehbaan sirf farishton ko qaraar diya hai aur un ki taadaad ko kuffaar ki aazmaaish ka zariya bana diya hai, ke Ahl-e-Kitaab ko yaqeen haasil ho jaaye aur imaan waalon ke imaan mein izaafa ho jaaye, aur Ahl-e-Kitaab ya saahibaan-e-imaan is ke baare mein kisi tarah ka shakk na karein, aur jin ke dilon mein marz hai aur kuffaar ye kehne lagein ke aakhir is misaal ka maqsad kya hai. Allah isi tarah jis ko chaahta hai gumraahi mein chhod deta hai aur jis ko chaahta hai hidaayat de deta hai, aur us ke lashkaron ko us ke ilaawa koi nahin jaanta hai. Ye to sirf logon ki naseehat ka ek zariya hai
Hoshiyaar! Humein chaand ki qasam
Aur jaati hui raat ki qasam
Aur roshan subah ki qasam
Ye Jahannam badi cheezon mein se ek cheez hai
Logon ke daraane ka zariya
Un ke liye jo aage peechhe hatna chaahein
Har nafs apne aamaal mein giraftaar hai
Ilaawa Ashaab-e-Yameen ke
Woh jannaton mein reh kar aapas mein sawaal kar rahe honge
Mujrimeen ke baare mein
Aakhir tumhein kis cheez ne Jahannam mein pahuncha diya hai
Woh kahenge ke hum namaaz-guzaar nahin the
Aur miskeen ko khaana nahin khilaaya karte the
Logon ke bure kaamon mein shaamil ho jaaya karte the
Aur roz-e-Qiyaamat ki takzeeb kiya karte the
Yahaan tak ke humein maut aa gayi
To unhein sifaarish karne waalon ki sifaarish bhi koi faaida na pahunchaaegi
Aakhir unhein kya ho gaya hai ke ye naseehat se munh mode hue hain
Goya bhadke hue gadhe hain
Jo sher se bhaag rahe hain
Haqeeqatan in mein har aadmi is baat ka khwaahishmand hai ke use khuli hui kitaabein ata kar di jaayen
Hargiz nahin ho sakta, asl ye hai ke inhein aakhirat ka khauf hi nahin hai
Haan haan, be-shak ye saraasar naseehat hai
Ab jis ka jee chaahe ise yaad rakhe
Aur ye ise yaad na karenge magar ye ke Allah hi chaahe, ke wahi daraane ka ahl aur maghfirat ka maalik hai
